ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
A uniform magnetic field of magnitude, $0.50 \, \mathrm{T}$, lies on the $x$-$y$ plane making a $60^\circ$ angle with the $x$-axis. When a $1.2 \, \mu\mathrm{C}$ point charge moves in the $+y$ direction, it experiences a force of magnitude, $3.0 \, \mu\mathrm{N}$. What is the speed of the charged particle?

The problem text states that the charge moves along the +y direction. From the image and text, it can be known that the magnetic field direction makes 60° with the +x axis, while the velocity direction is along the +y axis, that is, makes 90° with the +x axis, so the angle between the velocity and the magnetic field is 90° - 60° = 30°. The formula for the magnitude of the magnetic force is F = |q|vB sin(theta). Given F = 3.0 μN = 3.0e-6 N, q = 1.2 μC = 1.2e-6 C, B = 0.50 T, theta = 30°. Therefore v = F / (qB sin 30°) = 3.0e-6 / [(1.2e-6)(0.50)(0.5)] = 3.0e-6 / 3.0e-7 = 10 m/s.

method.method_draft: Resolve the magnetic field into components and use the cross product. From the image/text, B makes 60° with the +x-axis, so Bx = B cos 60° and By = B sin 60°. Since the particle velocity is along +y, the By component is parallel to the velocity and produces no magnetic force. Only the x-component contributes: F = |q|vBx = |q|vB cos 60°. Substitute B = 0.50 T, q = 1.2 μC, F = 3.0 μN: v = F/(qB cos 60°) = 3.0e-6 / [(1.2e-6)(0.50)(0.5)] = 10 m/s.

图像描述：图中有水平的 x 轴和竖直的 y 轴，磁场 B 的多条平行箭头位于 x-y 平面内，方向斜向右上方，并标出磁场方向与 +x 轴夹角为 60°。

推理：将磁场分解为分量：Bx = B cos 60°，By = B sin 60°。带电粒子的速度沿 +y 方向，因此 By 与速度方向平行，不产生磁力；只有垂直于速度的 x 分量产生磁力。磁力大小为 F = |q| v Bx = |q| v B cos 60°。代入 F = 3.0 × 10^-6 N，q = 1.2 × 10^-6 C，B = 0.50 T，cos 60° = 0.5，得到 v = F / (q B cos 60°) = 3.0 × 10^-6 / [(1.2 × 10^-6)(0.50)(0.5)] = 10 m/s。
